title: Pure Rescue-ACE
summary: Pure Rescue-ACE firefighting response build supported by generic staples. The engine revolves around Rescue-ACE Hydrant to enable Set Quick-Play Spells and Traps on the turn they are Set, responding dynamically to opponent actions with search tags and heavy disruption.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rescue-ACE Air Lifter searches any Rescue-ACE Spell on Normal or Special Summon, and tributes itself from hand or field when an opponent activates a monster effect on the field to Special Summon another Rescue-ACE monster from hand.
Rescue-ACE Quick Attacker shuffles a Rescue-ACE card from GY into the Deck to summon itself, and tributes itself to search any Rescue-ACE monster from your Deck.

Rescue-ACE Hydrant cannot be targeted for attacks or card effects while you control another Rescue-ACE monster, and allows Set Rescue-ACE Quick-Play Spells and Traps to be activated the turn they were Set.

EMERGENCY! Special Summons a Rescue-ACE monster from your Deck in Defense Position then tributes a Rescue-ACE monster from your hand or field, and banishes itself from the GY to Set a Rescue-ACE Trap directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Air Lifter + Any Rescue-ACE
steps: Normal Summon Rescue-ACE Air Lifter to search EMERGENCY! from your Deck.
Activate EMERGENCY! to Special Summon Rescue-ACE Hydrant from your Deck, then tribute Air Lifter.
With Hydrant face-up on the field, all Set Rescue-ACE Quick-Plays and Traps can be activated immediately during this turn.
Banish EMERGENCY! from the GY to Set CONTAIN! or EXTINGUISH! directly from your Deck, ready to disrupt the opponent immediately.
Special Summon Rescue-ACE Turbulence by banishing two Rescue-ACE cards from your GY to Set up to four Rescue-ACE Quick-Plays and Traps with different names from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Rescue-ACE Turbulence banishes 2 Rescue-ACE cards from your GY to Special Summon itself, then Sets up to 4 Rescue-ACE Quick-Play Spells and Traps with different names directly from your Deck.

Rescue-ACE Preventer banishes 1 Rescue-ACE card from your GY to Special Summon itself, flips an opponent's effect monster face-down as a Quick Effect, and floats into a banished Rescue-ACE monster when sent to the GY.
Rescue-ACE Arbitrator is a Link-4 boss that fetches Hydrant or Rescue-ACE HQ on Link Summon, and destroys 1 card on the field each time a Rescue-ACE Quick-Play or Trap is activated.
Rescue-ACE Impulse tributes itself from hand or field when an opponent activates a monster effect to shut down the opponent's highest ATK monster and Special Summon a Machine Rescue-ACE from Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: CONTAIN! negates an opponent's face-up effect monster, and while Hydrant is out, prevents it from attacking and prevents it from being used as material for Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summons.
EXTINGUISH! destroys an opponent's effect monster, and while Hydrant is out, prevents the opponent from activating effects of monsters with that original name this turn.
ALERT! adds a Rescue-ACE monster from your GY to your hand, or searches one directly from your Deck if Hydrant is on the field.
RESCUE! Special Summons a Rescue-ACE monster from your GY, or can Special Summon a monster from your opponent's GY if Hydrant is on the field.
Rescue-ACE HQ grants an extra Normal Summon of a Rescue-ACE monster and shuffles back 4 Rescue-ACE cards from your GY or banishment to draw 1 card.
